profile.visual_desc: Muscular grey-skinned humanoid machine. Wears a dark blue sleeveless tunic, red waist sash, and baggy dark trousers. Rear-isometric view facing ↖.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic profile with blue eyes and dark blue hair. Distinct black markings on the cheek. Determined expression, facing left.
profile.weapon_desc: Energy-enhanced fists; right hand serves as the primary strike point.
profile.step1_ready: Frame 1: Low crouched stance, back to camera, facing ↖. Arms held low at the sides.
profile.step2_windup: Frames 2-3: Stands upright and pulls the right fist back to head level, coiling for a powerful thrust.
profile.step3_impact: Frame 4: Lunges forward with a right-hand punch. A large, crescent-shaped golden energy wave sweeps from right to left.
profile.step4_finish: Frames 5-6: Right arm remains extended as the golden trail dissipates. Transitions back to a wide-legged neutral pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 must follow the horizontal right-to-left trajectory of the punching arm.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence maintains reference perspective and coiling. VFX arc aligns with arm trajectory and settles adequately.
